newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Airlines says adds new flights.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Airlines says adds new flights.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said Thursday it will add several new nonstop flights beginning Sept. 7 and Sept. 10.
The company said it will begin nonstop service between Tampa and Orlando and Albuqurque on Sept. 7.
The company will begin nonstop service between between Nashville and Baltimore/Washington, Providence, Orlando, Kansas City and Austin Sept. 10.
The company said the highest unrestricted fare customers will pay for travel from Orlando or Tampa to Albuqurque is $299.
The company did not provide information on the price of the new Nashville flights.
